Trump Allows Tax-Free Diesel Use to Lower Fuel Costs

Former U.S. President Donald Trump has authorized the temporary use of tax-free, red-dyed diesel fuel for nonfarm vehicles on U.S. highways. This measure is intended to address record-high fuel prices. The effectiveness of this policy in lowering costs is being questioned.
